site_subtitle: In the Footsteps of State Security Files – Source-based Research Platform
tagline: Free, public, map-based research platform for Hungarian state security records – every claim strictly backed by archival sources.

roles_desc.beszervezett_halozati_szemely: A person whose recruitment is verified by state security registers.
roles_desc.megfigyelt: A person targeted for surveillance by state security. A victim whose rights were infringed.
roles_desc.tiszt: A professional officer of the Ministry of Interior or local operational branch.
roles_desc.beszervezesi_kiserlet_alanya: A person whose recruitment was attempted but rejected or failed.
roles_desc.egyeb_emlitett: A person mentioned solely for contextual background in operative reports.
roles_desc.ismeretlen: Role not yet determined based on available files.

methodology.title: How to read state security files?
methodology.warning_text: This platform is NOT a defamatory name list. Mere mention in a file NEVER equates to being an agent. Archival records require source criticism and cross-verification.
methodology.card_6_desc: Primary record of an operational network person. Contains personal details, codename, date of recruitment, and case officer name.
methodology.b_naplo_desc: Chronological ledger of recruitments and dismissals. High evidentiary weight when cross-referenced with index cards.
methodology.h_adattar_desc: Summary registries showing the operative structure across counties and districts.
methodology.dual_verif_desc: No claim is published until independently validated by at least two researchers based on original archival text.

privacy.protected_notice: Non-anonymized personal data is made public strictly after the 5th calendar year following death. Living or unknown status individuals are legally protected.
privacy.private_residence_blurred: [Private residence – exact address and coordinates blurred to district level by law]
